IS 12348 : 1988 Use of Probability PapersUDC 519.213MSD3Reaffirmed 20201 Scope1.1 This standard covers the probability papers for normal, log-normal, exponential, Weibull, and binomial distributions, The procedure for estimating parameter(s) of the distribution has also been discussed. Each probability paper along with estimation of the parameter(s) has been illustrated with examples. Limitations on the use of probability papers for parameter(s) estimation has also been discussed.2 ReferencesIS 2 : 1960Rules for rounding off numerical valuesIS 9300 : Part 1 : 1979Statistical models for industrial applications: Part 1 Discrete modelsIS 9300 : Part 2 : 1979Statistical models for industrial applications: Part 2 Continuous models
